subject: Insurance
title: The ACA Marketplace
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The ACA Marketplace.

hook.text: The Affordable Care Act created insurance marketplaces where individuals shop for coverage.

buildup.text: Before the ACA, buying individual insurance was a nightmare.

discovery.text: Marketplace plans are standardized: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum.

twist.text: Subsidies make coverage affordable. A family earning $60,000 might pay only $200 a month for a Silver plan.

climax.text: The ACA marketplace gave millions access to coverage for the first time.

punchline.text: Bronze to Platinum. The ACA marketplace standardized individual coverage.

quiz.question: What tier of ACA plan has the lowest premium?
